scope: 32 high-impact claims selected for first-party audit; DOES NOT CERTIFY ALL sentences, quantitative models, vendor source links, code CVEs or security disclosures in uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: Root-depth /mp4-to-mp3 directly amplifies rankings or PageRank relative to /tools/audio/mp4-to-mp3
records.technical_reassessment: No official Google support for a direct ranking boost from fewer URL path segments. Google says URL path keywords alone hardly affect ranking and directories can help group large sites.
records.missing_verification: Build equivalent usable URL/graph fixture varying URL path and internal click distance independently; search outcome still unknown.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: Descriptive clean URL slugs help users and crawlers interpret destination
records.technical_reassessment: Descriptive human-readable URLs recommended for UX and breadcrumb display, not guaranteed extra rank.
records.missing_verification: Choose human-clear canonical slugs; do not use keyword repetitions.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: Contextual internal anchor links help discovery and understanding
records.technical_reassessment: Google explicitly uses links for finding pages/relevancy and recommends descriptive contextual internal links. No fixed page-count or link-quota advantage.
records.missing_verification: Verify real <a href> to each valuable task, click distance and no orphan important pages.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: Every FreeConvert important tool is within two clicks
records.technical_reassessment: Example nav shows many links but no complete live site graph or shortest-path traversal was executed.
records.missing_verification: Authorized sample crawl and BFS from homepage over canonical pages with redirects resolved.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: Links to sister sites automatically guarantee ranking-equity transfer
records.technical_reassessment: Offsite links can carry signals, but precise PageRank impact, thematic fit and link-spam intent are unknown.
records.missing_verification: Measure genuine human referrals, editorial relevance, source context and alternate cause.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: Domain age and exact-match text directly cause FreeConvert's #1 positions
records.technical_reassessment: Google's exact-match domain system limits undue credit; an aged domain alone or keyword-rich name is not a proven ranking formula.
records.missing_verification: Analyze dated link/brand/history separately; no age-as-rank multiplier.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: Distinct functional file-pair tools can be useful indexable destinations
records.technical_reassessment: Google policies allow useful distinct pages but warn against scaled/doorway pages designed to game rankings. A working button alone doesn't certify all thousands of routes.
records.missing_verification: Record distinct input/output behavior, error handling, useful differences per URL, canonical and real user task tests.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: Bulk URL creation is harmless whenever pages say different file formats
records.technical_reassessment: Google prohibits scaled content that primarily manipulates ranking and doorway variants that funnel users without distinct value.
records.missing_verification: Block programmatic publication absent a distinct validated user job and actual output oracle.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: FreeConvert likely exposes an inferred 45k–90k potential indexable-URL footprint based on page counts multiplied by locale variants
records.technical_reassessment: This is explicitly an inference in the uploaded report, not measured sitemap or Google indexing data. Exact sitemap and owner GSC unavailable.
records.missing_verification: Read actual sitemap index/individual files and unique canonical URLs; only site owner GSC can support indexed subset.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: Sitemap has 50,000 URL and 50 MB uncompressed limit per file
records.technical_reassessment: This applies to individual sitemap files, not a proof FreeConvert uses any particular partitioning.
records.missing_verification: Count locally generated canonical sitemap URLs and check file bytes before publish.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: /mp4-to-mp3 currently displays a real MP4-to-MP3 user journey and relevant links
records.technical_reassessment: Its public page exposes task title, input chooser, optional settings and extensive format links; no conversion result was tested.
records.missing_verification: Run legally permitted sample conversion and decode output before claiming successful functionality.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: Prefix/noun route variations always count as separate optimized SEO wins
records.technical_reassessment: Without comparing content and Google-selected canonicals, such URLs can be duplicate or near duplicate.
records.missing_verification: Record all variants, redirects, canonical, main body/action similarity and actual Google-selected canonical.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: Google AI Mode uses separate special URL depth ranking signals
records.technical_reassessment: Google says its AI search experiences use core Search ranking/quality systems and require ordinary indexed/snippet eligibility; no special URL depth optimization.
records.missing_verification: Validate Google Search index/snippet first, separate AI citation from query rank.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: AI Mode may generate related searches and retrieve relevant Search pages
records.technical_reassessment: Google explicitly documents query fan-out and Search index RAG. It does not publish exact fan-out query list or final citation weights.
records.missing_verification: Build useful task/evidence page and measure reported AI appearances, citations and human referrals distinctly.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: One landing page for every possible AI fan-out query ensures citations
records.technical_reassessment: Google warns such page proliferation to influence AI answers can violate scaled-content policy; strong semantic systems handle synonyms.
records.missing_verification: Group intent by real job, not AI prompt permutations; require unique outcome per indexed page.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: Google AI links are eligible only with special WebApplication structured data
records.technical_reassessment: Google says no special schema markup is needed for AI Mode/Overviews; normal Search index plus snippet eligibility.
records.missing_verification: Use schema only for truthful, supported rich-result uses, not as citation hack.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: WebApplication/SoftwareApplication markup can provide eligible rich-result information
records.technical_reassessment: Google supports SoftwareApplication and WebApplication as rich-result types with required fields and no guarantee of display; not a ranking formula.
records.missing_verification: Use only real relevant page/app info; do not invent ratings or prices; validate Google Rich Results Test.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: FreeConvert lacks JSON-LD sitewide and thus loses AI citations
records.technical_reassessment: Uploaded report only observed one extraction and explicitly did not parse all page <head> markup. Even absent JSON-LD would not establish lost citations.
records.missing_verification: Inspect raw and rendered script[type=application/ld+json] across sampled pages; no causal attribution.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: Publishing llms.txt produces a Google AI Mode visibility lift
records.technical_reassessment: Google Search says it ignores llms.txt and AI-only special files; other browser-agent tooling may separately inspect files.
records.missing_verification: No Google Search ranking/AI bonus from llms.txt; only create for a documented non-Google consumer.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: Chrome Lighthouse agentic browsing audit is a normal Google Search ranking signal
records.technical_reassessment: Official Chrome says agentic category is experimental, needs Chrome 150+; it produces pass ratios not a rank score, and is not Google Search ranking.
records.missing_verification: Run as experimental agent UI interoperability diagnostic, not SEO growth KPI.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: WebMCP is a universally supported mandatory browser/Google indexing requirement
records.technical_reassessment: Chrome documentation describes origin trial/early preview; Google Search says no extra AI Mode technical requirements.
records.missing_verification: Progressively enhance agent workflow for supported browsers, preserve normal accessible form flow.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: FreeConvert's modeled bounce rate and NavBoost leak prove Google uses its exact dwell time to rank it first
records.technical_reassessment: Schema field names, third-party aggregate bounce metrics and proprietary Google feature use/weights are distinct evidence classes. No causal proof.
records.missing_verification: Do not encode NavBoost, Craps, ChromeInTotal numerical heuristics; optimize actual user task outcome.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: Astro 71% benchmark versus Nuxt 29% automatically proves faster FreeConvert alternative and higher Google rank
records.technical_reassessment: Framework-level population correlations are confounded; FreeConvert origin-level CrUX not inspected, and Google says passing CWV does not guarantee rankings.
records.missing_verification: Measure own real p75 CWV and same-device per-task performance, not framework market averages.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: FreeConvert has 15 locale options and sample translated routes, with substantial localized footprint inferred
records.technical_reassessment: Visible language variants exist, but accurate translations, reciprocal hreflang, canonicalization and Google-selected indexed locale coverage were not verified.
records.missing_verification: Crawl representative locales, translation QA, reciprocal hreflang, canonical; inspect owned property where possible.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: Fathom estimated $292k/mo or scaled $442k/mo is FreeConvert's actual audited AdSense income
records.technical_reassessment: Models assume page RPM, all-channel visit estimates and pages/session, not publisher statements. Ad Manager/Prebid ad-tech presence does not equal verified AdSense revenue.
records.missing_verification: Do not state company profit/AdSense; label modeling scenario with sensitivity and all missing cost data.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: Astro plus static CDN and client-local conversion yields a modeled 99.9% gross margin even at massive conversion volumes
records.technical_reassessment: Avoiding server transcoding is real possible cost savings, but the supplied illustrative model omits multiple costs, error/retry distributions, distribution, human support, security, vendor and on-device resource economics.
records.missing_verification: Use net unit-cost ledger: conversions per device, effective byte processing, hosting/ops costs, SLA, error support and ad revenue.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: Client-side conversion automatically guarantees no user-file bytes are sent to any network
records.technical_reassessment: A claim about network behavior needs actual instrumentation; analytics, uploads, crash logs or remote fallback may still transmit content.
records.missing_verification: Offline with network interception, verify no content requests, worker isolation, third-party scripts, output correctness and explicit fallback status.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: AI Mode necessarily sends traffic to online converters because AI cannot process files
records.technical_reassessment: Some agents can execute code, call external conversion APIs, or process user content without clicking a public webpage; referral is a measured outcome not a necessity.
records.missing_verification: Measure explicit source citations, referrals and completed jobs; do not treat AI-mode page eligibility as guaranteed human sessions.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: FreeConvert's public navigation links to other specialized utility sites
records.technical_reassessment: Visible navigation includes ImageResizer, PhotoJoiner and several other task links, but external traffic/ranking transfer unknown.
records.missing_verification: Record contextual actual links/traffic source, not an automatic PageRank equity claim.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: A one-page heavy ad/tracker scan and population-wide Nuxt/Core-Web-Vitals statistics prove FreeConvert's origin-level Core Web Vitals or ranking disadvantage
records.technical_reassessment: A single third-party network trace and framework aggregates cannot establish site-level p75 field CWV or attributable Search ranking impact without actual URL/origin CrUX and controlled tests.
records.missing_verification: Measure controlled consent/account-specific scripts, p75 INP, CLS, user task completion and real ad eligibility.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: A third-party AI-readiness score proves bots are allowed and actual citations occurred
records.technical_reassessment: Numerical vendor readiness scores do not establish live crawler access, citation sources, indexing or causal impact.
records.missing_verification: Observe current provider-specific verified bot logs, external citations and owned referral sessions.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.

records.user_report_claim: FreeConvert's ad-tech identifiers reveal verified AdSense approval and its take-home revenue
records.technical_reassessment: GAM/Prebid/network calls demonstrate advertising technology presence, not connected publisher account details, contract, payout, policy center or profit.
records.missing_verification: Treat observed tags as ad-stack evidence only; never assert publisher status or earnings without owner records.
records.note: Verdict applies only to the specified causal or technical assertion, not every aspect of the 85KB uploaded report.
